title: Kodiak 100M aid-station chart (imperial, 2026 final, 10/6/2026 update)
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
claims: The 2026 100M chart places Start at 0.0 miles, Crab Flats at 8.4, Camp Whittle at 19.4, Van Dusen at 26.8, Doble Camp 1 at 33.7, Burns Canyon 1 at 39.7, Smarts Ranch at 47.5, Cactus Flats at 51.4, Doble Camp 2 at 55.4, Burns Canyon 2 at 61.5, Sugarloaf 1 at 69.3, Balky Horse at 78.1, Sugarloaf 2 at 83.0, Bear Mountain at 89.2, Snow Summit at 95.5 and the finish at 100.1 miles.

The chart gives cut-offs of 19:15 Friday at Camp Whittle, 23:30 Friday at Doble Camp 1, 05:30 Saturday at Cactus Flats, 07:30 Saturday at Doble Camp 2, 13:00 Saturday at Sugarloaf 1, 19:00 Saturday at Sugarloaf 2, 21:00 Saturday at Bear Mountain, 23:30 Saturday at Snow Summit and 01:00 Sunday at the finish.
The chart's cumulative figures are 15,735 ft of gain and 15,663 ft of loss (about 4,796 m and 4,774 m), while the race page header gives 4,876 m+.

The chart marks drop bags at the start, Camp Whittle, Doble Camp 1, Doble Camp 2, Sugarloaf 1, Sugarloaf 2 and the finish, and pacer pick-up at Doble Camp 2, Sugarloaf 1, Sugarloaf 2 and Bear Mountain; crew access is at the start, Doble Camp 1, Doble Camp 2, Sugarloaf 1, Sugarloaf 2, Bear Mountain, Snow Summit and the finish.
